_comment: PLACEHOLDER TOPOLOGY: Harsh must edit this to match the real system before deploy. Names, roles and guards below are an anonymised reconstruction, not the production graph.

nodes.label: Intake
nodes.role: Accepts the raw approval-rule request and request metadata.
nodes.guards: Malformed or empty requests entering the pipeline.

nodes.label: Normalisation
nodes.role: Canonicalises fields, units and entity references.
nodes.guards: Inconsistent casing, synonyms and unit drift.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.role: Decomposes the request into retrieval and drafting subtasks.
nodes.guards: Over-broad requests that would blow the latency budget.

nodes.label: Rule retriever
nodes.role: Pulls related existing approval rules for grounding.

nodes.label: Schema retriever
nodes.role: Fetches the valid field and operator schema.
nodes.guards: Drafts using fields that do not exist.

nodes.label: Example retriever
nodes.role: Finds nearest worked examples for few-shot grounding.
nodes.guards: Style and format drift from house conventions.

nodes.label: Draft generator A
nodes.role: Generates a candidate rule from the grounded context.
nodes.guards: Single-sample variance by drafting in parallel.

nodes.label: Draft generator B
nodes.role: Generates an alternative candidate under a different prompt.
nodes.guards: Single-sample variance by drafting in parallel.

nodes.label: Syntax validator
nodes.role: Checks each draft parses against the rule grammar.

nodes.label: Semantic validator
nodes.role: Checks the rule means what the request asked for.

nodes.label: Policy validator
nodes.role: Checks the rule against guardrail and policy constraints.

nodes.label: Repair agent
nodes.role: Rewrites drafts to fix issues the validators flagged.
nodes.guards: Discarding a near-correct draft instead of fixing it.

nodes.label: Re-validation
nodes.role: Re-runs validation on repaired drafts, looping back if needed.
nodes.guards: Shipping a repair that introduced a new error.

nodes.label: Ranker
nodes.role: Scores and ranks the validated candidates.
nodes.guards: Picking a weaker candidate by accident.

nodes.label: Explainer
nodes.role: Writes a plain-language rationale for the chosen rule.

nodes.label: Formatter
nodes.role: Serialises the result into the target JSON contract.

nodes.label: Audit
nodes.role: Records inputs, outputs and decisions for traceability.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.role: Returns the final rule to the caller.

nodes.label: Telemetry
nodes.role: Emits latency and quality metrics for monitoring.
